parameters.name: force
parameters.description: If nonzero, skip validation of properties, and permit setting unknown properties

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If nonzero, do not apply any changes (but still do validation and return 400 on errors)

400.description: Invalid properties.  Response is a map of property name to error string

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The name of the (sole) property to read from the config. Respects property aliases.

parameters.name: include_defaults
parameters.description: If false, only properties which have been changed from the default are included.

parameters.name: suppress_pending
parameters.description: If set, report the active runtime values for all configs. By default, properties with pending values (awaiting restart) report the pending value.

400.description: Invalid properties.  Response is a map of property name to error string

parameters.name: show_pending
parameters.description: If true, include the list of configs awaiting restart to apply pending values.

operations.summary: Get schema describing all cluster configuration properties

restart.description: Restart required to apply pending configuration

config_version.description: Configuration version number, for cross referencing with PUT results

invalid.description: List of properties with invalid values

unknown.description: List of properties unknown to this node

pending.description: List of properties with pending changes awaiting restart. Only populated for the node serving the request; for other nodes this list is empty.

cluster_config_write_result.description: Result of writing changes to cluster configuration

config_version.description: Configuration version number, for cross referencing with node config status

cluster_config_property_metadata_items.description: The type within 'items' for array properties

description.description: Human readable description of property's purpose

nullable.description: Whether this setting may be set to null

needs_restart.description: Whether changes to this property will require a restart of redpanda nodes

is_secret.description: Whether this property is a secret (i.e. should not be logged)

units.description: If applicable, the units of the property (e.g. ms, bytes)

example.description: Example of correct syntax for this property

type.description: Expected syntax of the property value

enum_values.description: Possible values of the property (in string-ized form)

items.description: Type of items in an array

aliases.description: List of legacy names for the property.  Property may be set using these names, but will always appear in GET requests via its primary name.

default_value.description: Default value, in string-ized form. Named default_value, not default, because 'default' is a reserved word in the generated C++ struct.

minimum.description: Lower bound, in string-ized form, for a bounded numeric property

maximum.description: Upper bound, in string-ized form, for a bounded numeric property

is_enterprise.description: Whether this property is wrapped in config::enterprise<> (may require a license to set to a restricted value)

enterprise_sanctioned_value.description: The community/sanctioned value used when there is no valid license, in string-ized (JSON-encoded) form. Only meaningful when is_enterprise is true.

enterprise_restricted_value.description: The value or array of values that require a license, in string-ized (JSON-encoded) form. Null when enterprise_restriction_is_dynamic is true (the restriction is a predicate function, not a static value).

enterprise_restriction_is_dynamic.description: True when is_enterprise is true but the restriction is a predicate function rather than a static value or list of values, so enterprise_restricted_value cannot describe it.
